questions.subject: CALCULUS_I
questions.learningObjective: Apply the quotient rule to a rational function
questions.stem: Brief 01: an architect models load ratio R(t)=(3t+2)/(t+1); which derivative is correct?
questions.explanation: The quotient rule simplifies to one over (t+1)^2 because the numerator derivative term cancels. The key is A, "1/(t+1)^2, using the quotient rule correctly", because it is the only choice consistent with the relation used above. Every other choice fails for a specific reason: B ("3/(t+1), differentiating the numerator only") differentiates numerator only; C ("(3t+2)/(t+1)^2, copying the numerator unchanged") copies numerator unchanged; D ("3(t+1)-(3t+2), omitting denominator square") omits denominator square.
